selection_policy: largest-area boat after merged NMS; confidence breaks equal-area ties
evaluation: Identical 20 validation frames and 100 negative photos; largest-area post-NMS boat selected before DINOv3; unchanged RGB crops and cached frozen features
baseline_note: Original color uses prior 12-variant reference; no-augmentation uses one scale-1 masked ship on the same canvas; augmented uses all 111 normalized features averaged.

threshold_calibration.method: Maximize frame pass rate minus negative false-positive rate (Youden J); ties: fewer false positives, then higher threshold.
threshold_calibration.limitation: Threshold tuned on these development images. Reported rates are in-sample; an independent held-out test is required.

ratio_filter.definition: width / height of nonzero unaugmented foreground mask bounds

limitation: Threshold tuned on these development images. Reported rates are in-sample; an independent held-out test is required.
